name: Build and drop arrangement
summary: Music bed for soundtrack.mjs: pads opening through a build, tuned 808 per bar, light drums before the drop and any genre pattern after it (per-bar 'four' for montage bars), snare roll and riser into a near-silent gap, the drop, and a ringing final chord. Places kicks from the shared KICKS list.

params.roots: 808 root per bar (MIDI 36-43 reads on phones)
params.style: drum pattern after the drop: trap | phonk | house | drill | lofi | boombap | dnb | hyperpop | four
params.endBar: bar index of the final chord (null to skip)
params.gap: seconds of near-silence before the drop

usage:
import { arrange } from './blocks/arrangement-build-drop/index.mjs';
const { dropAt } = arrange(mix, grid, { style: 'phonk', progression: PROGRESSIONS.darkPhonk, dropBar: 4, kicks: KICKS });
